page.content:
Global war of 1939–45 that remade states, borders, and international law.

How World War II connects

  • Faction: Axis — The Axis is the aggressive alliance of the Second World War.
  • Faction: Allies — The Allies are the coalition that defeated the Axis.
  • Event: Invasion of Poland — The Polish campaign is the conventional start of the world war in Europe.

What is World War II?

World War II is the public-domain historical record of the Axis bid for empire and the Allied response: from the invasion of Poland and Pearl Harbor through Stalingrad, D-Day, the Holocaust, and the bombs on Japan, to the United Nations that followed.

Key threads lead to Axis, Allies and Invasion of Poland.
